title: RAPRAL v1.0: RAdiation Prediction using RAy tracing and Line-by-line methods for hypersonic air flows
summary: A new radiation solver, RAPRAL (RAdiation Prediction based on RAy tracing and Line-by-line) implemented in C++, is developed for simulating high-temperature thermochemical nonequilibrium radiative processes. RAPRAL integrates detailed line-by-line spectral modeling with a ray-tracing solution of the radiative transfer equation, enabling accurate resolution of both spectral features and spatial radiation transport.
